gloss: to say everything; to express fully; to exhaust words

definitions.gloss: to say everything; to express fully; to exhaust words
definitions.explanation: To express something completely, leaving nothing unsaid. Most often used in the negative potential form, describing feelings too great to put fully into words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{尽|つ}くせない→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: I cannot fully express my gratitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{尽|つ}くせなかった→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't say all I felt in a short letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素晴|すば}らしさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{尽|つ}くせない→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧。
examples.english: No matter what words I use, I can't fully express how wonderful she is.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to exhaust, to use up completely). Most often appears in the negative potential form ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{尽|つ}くせない→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧, describing feelings too deep to put fully into words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{尽|つ}くせない→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧: feelings beyond words
- ⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{尽|つ}くす: to express one's full gratitude
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{尽|つ}くす: to describe every charm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to tell everything — focuses on narrating or discussing at length
- ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to express — neutral and general, without the nuance of completeness
